# sleep-aur 3.1.7

## Improvements

- The installer now deletes its temporary download directory immediately after a successful installation.
- `sleep-aur self update` removes the downloaded installer and checksum as soon as the update finishes.
- Release notes for previous versions are now maintained in the repository.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/the-sleepless/sleep-aur/compare/v3.1.6...v3.1.7
